approval.notes: The owner authorized execution of the approved plan in chat.

claims.lossy_verification_boundary: Verus proves memory safety, bounds, termination, and control-state correctness. Irreversible 9/7 numerical conformance and error tolerances are validated separately.

functional_refinement.profile_boundary: Selected-profile closure only; official Part 4 conformance remains pending, and encoding, network behavior, and ICC execution are out of scope.

maxshift_checkpoint.representation: six little-endian u64 limbs (384 bits), with checked indexing, shifts, comparison, addition, subtraction, and narrowing only after Maxshift undo
maxshift_checkpoint.execution: legacy significance/refinement and HT cleanup/SigProp/MagRef operate on bounded multi-limb magnitudes; inverse quantization and public typed sample output receive only ROI-restored i64 coefficients

part_1_codestream.unknown_marker_policy: Reject unknown or reserved markers unless the selected standard explicitly defines skip semantics.
part_1_codestream.trailing_bytes_after_eoc: Reject in raw codestream mode; container parsing is bounded by the containing box or databin.

jpx_multi_codestream_checkpoint.codestream_header_association: ordinal jpch association retained; full JP2-compatible headers and inherited ihdr/bpcc/colr/pclr/cmap/cdef/res partial headers parsed, applied, and cross-checked
jpx_multi_codestream_checkpoint.composition: bounded comp/copt/inst target/source geometry, life/persistence, next-use reuse, instruction repetition, loops, timing inspection, and indexed deterministic rendering
jpx_multi_codestream_checkpoint.compositing_layers: bounded jplh/creg inspection and rendering; selected-edition six-byte registration records, scaling, cgrp, opct, concatenated multi-codestream channels, layer cdef, mixed grayscale/sRGB, multiple associated alpha, and variable-precision chroma keys
jpx_multi_codestream_checkpoint.static_render_subset: header-order source-over into a bounded canvas with clipping, scaled registration, absent/straight/premultiplied/chroma-key alpha, and deterministic grayscale-to-sRGB promotion
jpx_multi_codestream_checkpoint.metadata: nested association boxes are structurally validated and depth/work bounded; labels, XML, UUIDs, and number lists remain opaque metadata rather than codec state

part_2_extensions.codestream_extensions: selected Part 2 decoder features; see explicit marker execution boundaries below
part_2_extensions.unknown_box_policy: Preserve type, offset, and bounded payload access for syntactically valid unknown boxes; never interpret them as codec state.

part_9_jpip.message_header_subset: Standard binary Bin-ID forms 01 (inherited class/CSn), 10 (explicit class with inherited/default-zero CSn), and 11 (explicit class/CSn); checked VBAS offset/length and optional odd-class Aux; EOR framing.
part_9_jpip.duplicate_overlap_policy: Identical duplicates and overlaps are idempotently merged; differing overlap bytes, conflicting final lengths, or bytes beyond final length fail without cache mutation.
part_9_jpip.completeness: A data-bin is complete only with an announced final length and contiguous coverage from offset zero through that length.
part_9_jpip.output: Owned bounded JpipByteView implementing AsRef<[u8]>; complete-bin codestream layout is main-header bin 0 plus matching ordered tile-header/tile-data pairs with SOC/EOC validation; container layout is caller-ordered complete metadata bins.
part_9_jpip.range_availability: JpipDatabinRange reports deterministic required/available bytes and exact closed missing intervals without requiring a final data-bin length; incomplete main/tile headers additionally report an open-ended missing tail until final length is announced.
part_9_jpip.precinct_packet_reconstruction: Both explicit JpipPrecinctCodestreamPlan ranges and automatic SIZ/COD/COC-derived maps are supported. Automatic in-class ID is tile + tile_count * (component + component_count * (sum of prior-resolution precinct counts + row-major precinct)); class 0/1 auxiliary-bit forms address one logical transactional bin.
part_9_jpip.precinct_codestream_transcoding: JpipAutomaticProgressiveDecoder supports multiple tiles, collapsible header-only multiple tile parts, LRCP/RLCP/RPCL/PCRL/CPRL plus retained POC windows, SOP/EPH, and PLM/PLT/PPM/PPT source signaling. Packet-length and packed-header markers are removed, precinct packets are parsed with the existing packet state machine and reframed inline, absent/unselected/later-quality packets become legal empty packets, Psot/EOC are regenerated, and the existing codestream parser validates output.
part_9_jpip.progressive_decode: Manual and automatic full/selected APIs decode the greatest contiguous available layer prefix, emit deterministic waiting/advanced/complete status plus next-layer missing ranges, and commit decoded_layers only after successful transcode and decode. Automatic selected updates reuse tile/region/reduced-resolution decode and add a component packet mask; output retains the source component schema.
part_9_jpip.metadata_semantic_assembly: assemble_semantic_container recursively expands standard phld metadata (flags=1) and incremental codestream (flags=4) placeholders from metadata-bin 0, preserves leaf versus superbox semantics, recomputes original 32/64-bit box lengths, detects cycles/depth/size failures, reconstructs complete codestreams from precinct bins, and validates JP2/JPX/JPH output with the existing parser. Missing bins/codestream quality return deterministic ranges and typed semantic needs.
part_9_jpip.tile_part_transition_metadata: tile_part_transitions retains each complete SOT-through-SOD header and derives packet counts from ordered PLT segments plus exact packet-data consumption from non-zero Psot. Later functional COD/COC/QCD/QCC/RGN/POC markers execute through effective raw decoder state even without PLT; incomplete precinct prefixes report missing ranges transactionally. Header bytes and derived data lengths are exposed for exact reconstruction.
part_9_jpip.cache_model_signaling_selection: Not selected. No pinned public source currently provides sufficient field-level syntax provenance for the selected 2026 edition, so signaling is not guessed.
part_9_jpip.notes: Network transport, request generation, authentication, TLS, server behavior, and request/window scheduling are not exposed and remain out of scope.

profile_detection_checkpoint.container: canonical jph primary brand, minor version zero, and sole jph compatible brand
codestream_signals: COD/COC legacy, HT-only, and mixed style prefixes
profile_detection_checkpoint.mixed_legality: 00 legacy, 01 HT-only, and 11 mixed SPcod/SPcoc prefixes accepted; reserved 10 rejected; Ccap15 HTONLY, HTDECLARED, and MIXED constrain effective main/tile component styles and reserved Ccap mode 01 is rejected
profile_detection_checkpoint.metadata: bounded retained Rsiz, Pcap/Ccap values, PRF/CPF words, and aggregate block-coding classification
profile_detection_checkpoint.execution: container and codestream inspection complete; cleanup, SigProp, and MagRef HT blocks are decoded through packet/layer routing, coefficient reconstruction, inverse quantization, and raw/top-level JPH output
malformed_rejections: non-canonical JPH brands or compatible-brand lists
JPH branding on a non-Part-15 codestream (HTDECLARED may legally contain only legacy code-blocks)
HT codestream in a non-JPH container

block_segment_checkpoint.pass_grouping: zero or more initial three-pass placeholder groups followed by one or more cleanup plus zero-to-two-refinement HT sets are routed across packet and layer contributions; partial final sets and zero-length skipped sets are accepted
block_segment_checkpoint.cleanup_termination: Scup is decoded from the final 12 cleanup bits and constrained to 2..=min(Lcup, 4079); unused physical MagSgn bits must be one-valued cleanup termination fill
block_segment_checkpoint.substreams: MagSgn and combined MEL/VLC physical regions are checked and non-overlapping; bounded forward MagSgn/MEL and reverse VLC readers cannot consume across their physical boundaries
block_segment_checkpoint.refinement: bounded LSB-first forward SigProp and reverse MagRef readers apply directional stuffing, fill, shared-byte collision, and termination checks; legal empty refinement payloads are retained
block_segment_checkpoint.limits: 4096 samples, 874 declared passes (292 bit-planes), 65534 cleanup bytes, 2046 refinement bytes, 67580 aggregate code-block bytes, and caller work ceilings
block_segment_checkpoint.remaining_boundary: none for normative Part 15 pass-set shapes; inaccessible profile-number registries remain retained metadata rather than inferred semantics

cleanup_metadata_checkpoint.readers: forward MSB-first MEL and reverse LSB-first VLC readers apply HT stuffing and reject bit-granular cursor collisions in the shared region
cleanup_metadata_checkpoint.mel: bounded 13-state adaptive run decoder emits zero/one events with explicit truncation and work errors
cleanup_metadata_checkpoint.vlc: initial and non-initial 1024-word lookup representations are derived from the pinned public BSD-2-Clause OpenJPEG implementation; codeword and UVLC bits are bounded before consumption
cleanup_metadata_checkpoint.metadata: checked quad origins, contexts, significance, embedded-magnitude flags, u-offsets, and base-u values for at most 4096 samples
cleanup_metadata_checkpoint.validation: rejects malformed stuffing, forward/reverse collisions, truncated codewords, invalid u bounds, significance outside odd block edges, arithmetic overflow, and work-limit exhaustion
cleanup_metadata_checkpoint.coefficient_boundary: implemented transactionally for cleanup, SigProp new significance/signs, and MagRef bin-center replacement

cleanup_reconstruction_checkpoint.magsgn: bounded LSB-first forward reader applies 0xFF stuffing, uses one-valued cleanup termination fill without crossing into MEL, accounts physical and fill bits, and rejects malformed physical termination
cleanup_reconstruction_checkpoint.kappa: non-initial multi-significant quads complete base-u from the maximum retained north-boundary exponent with checked 2-bit threshold subtraction
cleanup_reconstruction_checkpoint.coefficients: embedded magnitude, MagSgn magnitude bits, sign, bin-center reconstruction, bit-plane alignment through 292 planes, bounded six-limb magnitude operations, and transactional plane writes are implemented
cleanup_reconstruction_checkpoint.integration: packet contribution, decode_code_block, raw codestream, and canonical JPH paths produce cleanup and refined HT coefficients and image samples
cleanup_reconstruction_checkpoint.remaining: none for legal placeholder, SINGLEHT, or MULTIHT cleanup/SigProp/MagRef coding-pass sets

refinement_checkpoint.sigprop: four-row stripes and four-column patches scan columns then rows; newly significant membership propagates within the patch before raw signs are consumed in scan order
refinement_checkpoint.magref: reverse-coded decisions apply only to cleanup-significant samples and replace the cleanup bin center with checked lower/upper refinement centers
refinement_checkpoint.atomicity: cleanup and all available refinement contributions decode into private planes; public decoder state, byte/pass accounting, and coefficients commit only after all readers and termination checks succeed
refinement_checkpoint.routing: cleanup and refinement segments can arrive together or across later packet/layer contributions; accumulated refinement is re-decoded from the retained cleanup plane when MagRef arrives; each later non-empty MULTIHT cleanup starts a lower-precision replacement set
refinement_checkpoint.mixed: mixed mode defers across zero-length placeholders, then uses Lblock > 3 plus the zero first bit of the first non-zero segment length to select HT; otherwise legacy routing is retained for the code-block lifetime
refinement_checkpoint.capabilities: Ccap15 reserved bits, HTONLY/HTDECLARED/MIXED, SINGLEHT/MULTIHT, RGNFREE/RGN, HOMOGENEOUS/HETEROGENEOUS, HTREV/HTIRV, and B=8..74 magnitude-bound combinations are parsed and enforced

container_and_color.palette: implemented for JP2 typed output with retained 1-38 bit signed/unsigned columns and range-checked lookup
container_and_color.component_mapping: implemented for bounded direct and palette mappings
container_and_color.channel_definition: implemented as preserved typed per-output-channel metadata and consumed by explicit bounded color conversion; compositing is not implied

irreversible: signed int16 converted to deterministic Q32 as required
signed int32 converted to deterministic Q32 as required

selective_decode.tile_subset: one tile or a unique rectangular tile-index set fully covering the requested region
selective_decode.region_coordinates: absolute SIZ image-reference-grid coordinates, half-open, origin-aware; component bounds use checked subsampling and reduction ceiling division
selective_decode.resolution_semantics: discard N highest DWT levels and return the native JPEG 2000 reduced resolution, not a post-decode resize

selective_decode.limits: packet, precinct, code-block, work, and decoded-byte checks charge selected execution; unavoidable packet framing remains input/work accounted

runtime.thread_safety: Independent decoder instances may be used concurrently. Immutable configuration is Send + Sync; decoder state is Send and not shared during mutation.

resource_limits.policy: Defaults are hard upper bounds for the first-release profile. Callers may lower but not raise them.
resource_limits.work_unit_definition: One bounded marker, box, packet, tag-tree node, code-block pass, coefficient, lifting step, MCT matrix multiply, or JPIP fragment operation as specified per module.
